review.en: Françoise Hardy's first album arrived at the height of French yé-yé, when most young singers recorded songs handed to them. She wrote most of these herself, and the title song became a major hit in France. The record is short and plainly arranged; its lasting interest is a songwriter's voice emerging inside a teen-pop industry.
review.zh: 这张首专出现在法国耶耶流行最盛的时候，那时年轻歌手多半唱别人写好的歌，阿尔迪却自己写了其中大部分。同名曲在法国大热。唱片短小，编曲朴素；它真正留下的，是一个创作者在青春流行工业里长出自己的声音。
